item.childrenofmu.levitation_shard.toolt: While held, you sink gently and never fall hard.
telepathy.childrenofmu.greet.0: %s, in your mind: You are early. Or we are late. It is difficult to say.
telepathy.childrenofmu.greet.1: %s regards you. A voice that is not a voice: Your era is brief and loud. Tread softly here.
telepathy.childrenofmu.greet.2: %s does not turn, yet you feel yourself being catalogued.
telepathy.childrenofmu.greet.3: %s, in your mind: Another small mind, wandering. Welcome, small mind.
%s, in your mind: Matter is only a habit. We can break it of its habits. For a price.
%s, in your mind: Coal remembers being a diamond. It merely needs reminding.
%s turns its cones slowly. Everything you carry could be something else.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.archivist.0: %s, in your mind: Bring us what your kind has written down. We will tell you what it meant.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.archivist.1: %s, in your mind: Every song is a record. Every record is a door. We collect doors.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.archivist.2: %s adjusts its cap. You sense it has read everything, twice, in an order you could not survive.
%s, in your mind: There are other places. There are always other places. Some of them are expensive.
%s, in your mind: The End is not an end. We know where its edges are.
%s draws its cape close. Inside, briefly, you see a sky that is not this one.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.curator.0: %s, in your mind: You carry rare things carelessly. Let us care for them instead.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.curator.1: %s, in your mind: The collection is incomplete. It is always incomplete. That is the point.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.curator.2: %s tucks its scarf tighter and looks over your belongings with open interest.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.quiescent.0: %s, in your mind: We are not idle. We are complete. There is a difference, and one day you will feel it.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.quiescent.1: %s, in your mind: We have nothing to sell you. Sit a while. The stars are moving; watch them with us.
telepathy.childrenofmu.trade.quiescent.2: %s rests in the air like a held breath. You feel, for a moment, that nothing needs doing.
telepathy.childrenofmu.phase.0: %s withdraws from this moment. Your blow strikes only the memory of it.
telepathy.childrenofmu.phase.1: %s, sharply: That was unwise. Do not repeat it.
telepathy.childrenofmu.phase.2: %s flickers, and is elsewhere in the same place.
telepathy.childrenofmu.cast.0: %s, coldly: You are no longer here.
telepathy.childrenofmu.cast.1: %s removes you from its presence, as one brushes away dust.
post.childrenofmu.registered: You've found the post box of %s. Frog couriers can now carry your parcels here.
post.childrenofmu.explain: %s: "Hand me something to carry, and I'll hop it to any town whose post box you've opened. One emerald a parcel."
post.childrenofmu.nowhere: %s: "I'd love to, but you haven't opened the post box in any other town yet. Find one and I'll know where to go."
post.childrenofmu.hover: Send it to %s (arrives in about %s min, 1 emerald)
post.childrenofmu.sent: %s tucks %s into the satchel. "It'll be in the %s post box in about %s minutes!"
post.childrenofmu.fee: %s: "That'll be one emerald for the stamp."
post.childrenofmu.gone: The courier has hopped off. Find one and try again.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.0: The Treasurer counts the gold twice every night. I've heard him laughing at it.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.1: Don't drink from the pump house. The Plumber says it's fine. The Plumber also said that last time.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.2: The Fisher swears he saw a fish with legs. We told him that was just Gerald.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.3: Somebody's been eating the Chitinier's honey. The froglets have very sticky faces.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.4: The Coppersmith's roof gets hit by lightning on purpose. On purpose!
gossip.childrenofmu.town.5: The Potioneer's new leaping draught put Old Pip on the guard tower roof. He's still up there.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.6: Quiet night. Too quiet. I think the reeds are planning something.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.7: The couriers race each other home. The losers have to sort the mail.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.8: The Elder's been telling the eyeball story again. He gets bigger eyes every time.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.9: Mosquitoes were thick this morning. Good morning, in other words.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.10: A heron flew over at dawn. Everyone stood very still for an hour.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.11: Someone left a boat tied to my stilt again. I'm keeping it.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.12: They say if you whisper into the post box, a frog somewhere far away hears it.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.13: The froglets learned a new song. It's mostly the word 'ribbit'. They're very proud.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.14: The Treasurer says emeralds are just green gold. The Treasurer has never been to a jeweler.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.15: I don't trust the cats. One asked me the time and now I can't find my clock.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.16: The bats came through playing jazz last full moon. Nobody slept, nobody minded.
gossip.childrenofmu.town.17: Watch your step on the boardwalk by the dock. There's a loose plank, and also Gerald.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.0: Letter came in from %s. Their mayor fell in the pond again.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.1: My cousin in %s says their lily pads are bigger. They are not.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.2: The couriers say %s has a new potion that makes you croak in harmony.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.3: There's a froglet in %s who can jump clean over the guard tower. Or so I'm told.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.4: Heard %s ran out of honey. Riots. Small, polite riots.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.5: Someone in %s keeps posting rocks to people. Just rocks. Nobody knows why.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.6: Word from %s: a stranger opened their post box and stared into it for a long time.
gossip.childrenofmu.afar.7: The %s guards claim they've never fallen asleep on watch. Liars, the lot of them.
gossip.childrenofmu.ithk.near: They say the eyeball folk float over the land to the %s. Not far, maybe %s blocks.
gossip.childrenofmu.ithk.mid: The couriers talk of crystal towers to the %s, about %s blocks off. Floating eyes live there.
gossip.childrenofmu.ithk.far: Old stories put an Ithk village far to the %s, %s blocks or more. Eyes that never blink.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.0: The Ithk do not blink, little one. They build lids of stone to rest behind.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.1: Beneath the cat city, the rats keep everything clean. Some of them never leave their homes. They only groom.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.2: Never trust a cat with an empty paw. It was full a moment ago.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.3: The bats play all night up in their roosts. In my youth I danced until the herons woke.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.4: The Log folk were woodcutters once. A wizard of the trees cursed them. Mind your axe near them.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.5: There are folk too small to see, unless you wear the right charm. Plant trees, and perhaps they'll trust you.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.6: The Goxa want such strange things for their wares. I once traded my second-best memory.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.7: The dogs to the east keep the old ways: bow, blade and horse.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.8: Our town was a single stilt once. One stilt, one frog, one very long day.
gossip.childrenofmu.elder.9: Gold is heavy, emeralds are pretty, but a good pond is worth more than either.
kitchen.childrenofmu.menu: %s: "Ah, a guest! Everything is made fresh, to order. Tonight's menu:"
kitchen.childrenofmu.served: %s: "Your %s, fresh from the kitchen. Bon appétit!"
kitchen.childrenofmu.busy: %s: "The kitchen is full to the gills. Come back in a moment."
kitchen.childrenofmu.poor: %s: "That dish is %s emeralds. Quality has a price, darling."
kitchen.childrenofmu.gone: The chef has wandered off. Find him and ask again.
kitchen.childrenofmu.cook.0: %s: "Orders go through Chef! I just chop."
kitchen.childrenofmu.cook.1: %s: "Don't touch the soufflé. Nobody touches the soufflé."
kitchen.childrenofmu.cook.2: %s: "Twelve emeralds for a beetle. Don't tell him I said that."
kitchen.childrenofmu.cook.3: %s: "Mind your feet, the floor's all honey."
law.childrenofmu.demand.vandalism: %1$s: Oi! That's city property. %2$s emeralds or %3$s raw fish. Now.
law.childrenofmu.demand.theft: %1$s: Hands where I can see 'em. Light-fingered, are we? %2$s emeralds or %3$s raw fish, and we'll say no more.
law.childrenofmu.demand.assault: %1$s: Assault, in my city? That'll be %2$s emeralds. Or %3$s raw fish. I'm not fussy.
law.childrenofmu.demand.murder: %1$s: Murder. Right. %2$s emeralds or %3$s raw fish, and be quick, before I lose interest in the money.
law.childrenofmu.more: %1$s: That's a start. %2$s emeralds more. Or %3$s fish.
law.childrenofmu.again: %1$s: You again. You still owe %2$s emeralds. Or %3$s fish.
law.childrenofmu.owe: %1$s: You owe the city %2$s emeralds. Or %3$s raw fish. Throw it here.
law.childrenofmu.chat.2: %1$s: Keep your nose clean and we'll get along fine.
law.childrenofmu.chat.3: %1$s: Got any fish? No reason. Just asking.
law.childrenofmu.chat.4: %1$s: Break anything, take anything, hit anybody, and we'll be having words. Expensive words.
law.childrenofmu.chat.5: %1$s: Fights are in the pit. Anywhere else it's assault.
law.childrenofmu.chat.7: %1$s: We don't do dungeons. Saves on paperwork.
pit.childrenofmu.no_pit: %1$s: No pit, no fights, no book. Shame.
pit.childrenofmu.closed: %1$s: Book's closed, chum. Watch and learn.
pit.childrenofmu.later.0: %1$s: Next bout soon. Keep your emeralds warm.
pit.childrenofmu.later.1: %1$s: Nothing on just now. Calf at the bar while you wait?
pit.childrenofmu.later.2: %1$s: Fighters are warming up. Come back in a bit.
pit.childrenofmu.card.0: %1$s: Roll up! In the pit: %2$s against %3$s! One cat, three rats! Bets pay double:
pit.childrenofmu.card.1: %1$s: Roll up! Rat against rat: %2$s versus %3$s! Bets pay double:
pit.childrenofmu.card.2: %1$s: Roll up! A proper cat fight: %2$s versus %3$s! Bets pay double:
pit.childrenofmu.gone: The bookie's not taking bets from here.
pit.childrenofmu.poor: %1$s: Come back when you've got the emeralds.
pit.childrenofmu.taken: %1$s: %2$s emeralds on %3$s. Good luck, you'll need it.
pit.childrenofmu.draw: %1$s: Time! No winner. Stakes back, everybody.
pit.childrenofmu.won: %1$s: %2$s emeralds. Don't spend it all at once.
item.childrenofmu.writ_of_trade.city: Sealed by the Great Gar of %s
item.childrenofmu.writ_of_trade.until: Good until the morning of day %s
gar.childrenofmu.title: the Great Gar of %s
gar.childrenofmu.demand: %1$s: *shifts enormously* No one trades in %2$s without My writ. %3$s emeralds. Then you may scurry about doing business for nine days.
gar.childrenofmu.granted: %1$s: *a paw stamps the wax* There. Trade, bet, prosper. In %2$s, everything is Mine anyway.
gar.childrenofmu.still_good: %1$s: You already have My writ for %2$s. Good for %3$s more day(s). Now stop blocking My light.
gar.childrenofmu.no_writ.0: %1$s: No writ, no trade. The Great Gar of %2$s sells them, up in the Justice Hall.
gar.childrenofmu.no_writ.1: %1$s: Can't deal with you without a Writ of Trade. The Gar's rules. Top of the Justice Hall in %2$s.
gar.childrenofmu.no_writ.2: %1$s: *looks around nervously* Got a writ? No? Then I never saw you. Go and pay the Great Gar of %2$s first.
law.childrenofmu.treason: %1$s: You raised a paw to the Great Gar?! GUARDS! No fines for this one.
gar.childrenofmu.mourning: %1$s: Trade? Now? The Great Gar of %2$s is dead. Nobody deals until the new Gar sits.
gar.childrenofmu.dead: The Great Gar of %s is dead! The bells toll; every writ he sealed is void, and the city will remember who did it.
gar.childrenofmu.new: A new Great Gar sits on the cushion in %s. Writs of Trade may be bought again.
